title: Assignment lifecycle
description: Guide a SpecDev assignment from creation through brainstorm, breakdown, implementation, review, and completion.

create-assignment.purpose: Create and focus the assignment with an explicit type and slug.
create-assignment.instructions: Run `specdev assignment "<description>" --type=<type> --slug=<slug> --json` and submit its JSON result.

brainstorm.purpose: Produce and validate the assignment proposal and design with the user.
brainstorm.instructions: Follow `.specdev/skills/core/brainstorming/SKILL.md`. Write `brainstorm/proposal.md` and `brainstorm/design.md`, then submit their paths and a summary.

sideChannelActions.purpose: Run `specdev research <topic>` and record research without advancing the assignment.

brainstorm-checkpoint.purpose: Validate the brainstorm artifacts before review or approval.
brainstorm-checkpoint.instructions: Run `specdev checkpoint brainstorm --json` and submit `{"passed":true}` only after it succeeds.

brainstorm-review-choice.purpose: Choose how to review and approve the brainstorm.

interaction.prompt: How should the brainstorm be reviewed?

choices.label: Automated review, then continue if approved

brainstorm-review.purpose: Complete the selected brainstorm review and resolve all findings.
brainstorm-review.instructions: Run the selected review command from the preceding choice. Use `specdev check-review` and revise artifacts until the review is approved, then submit completion evidence.

approve-brainstorm.purpose: Ensure the brainstorm gate is approved.
approve-brainstorm.instructions: Run `specdev approve brainstorm --json` if the selected review did not already approve it. Submit the successful approval result.

breakdown.purpose: Create the implementation plan from the approved design.
breakdown.instructions: Follow `.specdev/skills/core/breakdown/SKILL.md`, write `breakdown/plan.md`, and submit its path and task count.

implementation.purpose: Execute the approved implementation plan and record task progress.
implementation.instructions: Run `specdev implement`, follow `.specdev/skills/core/implementing/SKILL.md`, complete the plan, and submit the progress path and summary.

sideChannelActions.purpose: Read and address external review feedback without advancing implementation.

implementation-checkpoint.purpose: Validate completed implementation evidence before review or approval.
implementation-checkpoint.instructions: Run `specdev checkpoint implementation --json` and submit `{"passed":true}` only after it succeeds.

implementation-review-choice.purpose: Choose how to review and approve the implementation.

interaction.prompt: How should the implementation be reviewed?

choices.label: Automated review, then continue if approved

implementation-review.purpose: Complete the selected implementation review and resolve all findings.
implementation-review.instructions: Run the selected review command, address findings with `specdev check-review`, and submit completion evidence only when review is approved.

approve-implementation.purpose: Ensure the implementation gate is approved.
approve-implementation.instructions: Run `specdev approve implementation --json` if needed and submit the approval result.

knowledge-capture.purpose: Capture durable project and workflow knowledge from the completed assignment.
knowledge-capture.instructions: Follow `.specdev/skills/core/knowledge-capture/SKILL.md`. Submit a short summary, including `none` when no durable update is warranted.
